verdict.rationale: Better Stack ships AI features (an AI SRE agent, an MCP server, and a choice of LLM providers), so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack has no statement about AI training on customer data, no opt-out control, and no no-training guarantee. Model selection and the approval requirement for AI actions are adjacent features and do not address training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
